I will do this maize plot much like last time, because cash is tight and this land is rented, so I do not want to put too much money inside it. If I can get one bag together with help from home, I will put chemical fertilizer, but not plenty, and I will use my saved local seed because improved seed costs more and many women here go without it. I will not irrigate because I depend on rain, and I will use mostly my own family work, only calling a few people when clearing or weeding is too much.
